abstract.text: The Map is the first screen in LinkMap. It stays visible even before you choose a Project.

inlineContent.text: Open Dashboard → Context to select a Project, Activity, and optional Assignment. The Map shows the selected Project’s Locations. Selecting an Activity adds its Routes; selecting an Assignment focuses the view on that team’s work.
Tap a Location marker to open its actions, then choose Detail. Use the Map toolbar’s Edit Locations action to add or move places. Save to keep changes or Cancel to discard them.

abstract.text: Use LinkMap to plan places and shared work from the Map.
Locations are the places your team needs to find or visit, such as entrances, rooms, checkpoints, or delivery points.
A Project brings together the places and activities for one area or shared effort.
Regions divide a Project into broad areas. Layers describe levels or surfaces inside a Region, such as floors in a building.
